title: Power Automate Says SUCCESS. Your Excel Data Is Still OLD! #shorts
description: A green Power Automate cloud flow does NOT always mean an Excel Power Query connection refreshed. Microsoft's Office Scripts documentation describes a case where the refresh method can succeed without updating a non-Power BI source. An illustrative sales report shows why you must verify the source and output. #excel #powerautomate #powerquery #shorts

captions.text: The flow says success. But the dashboard is old.
A cloud Office Script can finish without refreshing the CSV.
The source has sixteen orders. Excel still has twelve.
Verify the rows and totals, not the green badge.

visual_note: Illustrative reconstructed UI and invented sales numbers; no claim this was recorded from a live Microsoft account.
